page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Marginal notes in the right margin: "Regni Polonici." at the top, "(1) origo." beside the first paragraph, and "(2) Minutio." beside the line "Silesia à Rege Poloniæ defecit." Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.head: Explic.
main_text.p: Regni Polonici.Polonorum gentem condidit Le-chus, frater Czechii & Rusi A.C.550 (1) ori-go.Hujus familiâ extinctâ successit A.C.700 Cracus, à quo Cracovia structa. Tertiam Principum familiam fundavit A.C.830 Rusticus quidam Piastus, qui diutissimè regnavit.
main_text.head: His successerunt Reges.
main_text.p: Poloniæ Primus Rex creatus fuit ab Ottone III Boleslaus Chobrius. Sed, cùm posteà Boleslaus Audax Sanctum Stanislaum Episcopum Cracovien-sem nefariè obtruncasset, Polonia per 115[?] annos titulo Regio abstinuit usq; ad A.C. 1295, quo Premislaus, post tàm diuturnum interregnum, Regium Diadema recepit, & ad posteros transmisit.
Silesia à Rege Poloniæ defecit.(2) Mi-nutio.
